sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Removes resurrection, wards, invincibility, damage reflection, continuous healing, and damage reduction effects.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 460. Success value 100. Magic damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies resurrection.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 50 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies hero for 60 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies debuffs, status ailments, and Unison gauge reduction; nullifies buffs [Demerit]; reduces healing effects received by 70% [Demerit]).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8000
